head: d5831d7613e8c8edd2adf76fbd7b86b408e62de6
verified: Retains selected tiny-upload guardian restriction and first8/last8 samples plus capped16 upload-size histogram.
Adds one Process dictionary context per selected guardian, holding only two correlation refs, operation atom, timestamps and scalar poll count; removed on DOWN and reclaimed when observer exits.
Correlates h3_command/h3_result refs without examining or serializing opaque Session values or arguments.
Measures command elapsed time, arrival-to-upload-reply, ingress gaps and poll counts using trace monotonic timestamp converted to microseconds; aggregates only count,total,min,max scalars.
Poll result analysis recognizes public event tuple tags only, retaining no bodies, headers, metadata or Session. Message shapes match public Gaoxy envelope producers/consumers.
Original fixture mailbox256, assertions, finite deadlines and product behavior remain unchanged; trace flags disabled at stop and dead-PID sends ignored.
limits: Timing context assumes the existing serial guardian command/upload flow; these metrics are diagnostic observations, not protocol acceptance.
Tracing can affect scheduling; no runtime correctness or UP2 PASS claimed.
No runtime/test/format/dependency/module commands run by reviewer.
